author: Jonathan Hill

body:
Hey again everyone. It's been an exciting few days - we've jumped from 8 discoveries to 19 in the few days since our last announcement! There are over 50 enchants total, so still tons to find, but great work so far! It's time to announce the build contest winners, and give a few more days’ worth of general updates.

🔭Observatory: Build Contest Winners

Thanks much to all the entrants, these were really fun to judge! Here are the top 3 entries:

  • 🥇1st Place: J1mbers and Krashafa - A perfect score from all judges! Your warp is set as Observatory1.

  • 🥈2nd Place: Starmarsh and Daria! Your warp is set as Oculus as requested.

  • 🥉3rd Place: A tie!

    • Maidl and TroyTheCrafter! Your warp is set as Observatory3.,

    • TheJ_Team! Your warp is set as Observatory4.

Congrats winners! For all entrants, your prize money has been distributed (split evenly where necessary) and your prize items are in a bundle on the bottom row of the submitter's ender chest (J1mbers, Star, and Maidl for the joint entries). Winners, feel free to request a free warp rename if desired.

📝General Updates

  • 💎Socketing

    • Gem socketing now works for custom helmets!

    • Note that Runecrafted enchants can be applied to custom helmets. This isn't new, but stating it for visibility.

  • 🪙Shops

    • Updated the stock and price of items sold at ‘/warp buyables’. Notably, we now sell Creaking Spawn Eggs, Gilded Blackstone, and Reinforced Deepslate.

    • You can sneak + punch to bulk sell to the server shop. This was changed a little while back, but listing it for visibility.

  • 📖Runecrafting Event:

    • The enchant research quest board now displays % progress of ongoing projects, and a board has been added for new discoveries from this expansion.

  • ✏️Miscellaneous

    • Fixed potions brewing directly to their extended state and sometimes not granting mcMMO Alchemy XP.

    • You can now cleanse candles in a cauldron to undye them.

    • Added a toggle in /toggle sounds to disable the sound that plays every jump with Avatar of Slimes.

🫶
